_comment: Bundles the headless harness cannot yet drive, and WHY. These are harness limitations, not game bugs — each plays fine in the studio and on device. Listed so `--all` stays usable as a CI gate without quietly forgetting them. The durable fix is not a better DOM shim: it is for the game to DECLARE its move space via FR.host `options`, which is how SUMMIT came off this list. A game built on FR.host needs no DOM to be played or fuzzed at all.
tapas: Same shape as summit — pick a card into local state, then confirm.
fishbowl: Reaches turnReady with its bot, then needs the giver's own timed guess loop; the shim's element identity isn't stable enough across re-renders for the giver's controls to stay wired.
